headline: Approved nomination of Jacqueline Kelley for membership to the HRPC.
summary: The committee discussed accessibility updates including a Ward 6 polling entrance change, a crosswalk issue at Riverside and Hillside, and the upcoming 36th anniversary of the Americans with Disabilities Act. Members also worked on a PlanBTV 2050 wishlist and approved nominating Jacqueline Kelley for committee membership.
decisions: Approved nominating Jacqueline Kelley, UVM Accessibility Partner, for membership to the HRPC.

decision_evidence.quote:
Motion by LB to nominate Jacqueline Kelley for membership to the HRPC.
o Seconded by KD
o All in favor, so moved and approved.

plain_text:
Advisory Committee on Accessibility 
 
 
Monday, July 20, 2026, 3:00 PM, 3:00 pm, Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 149 
Church Street, OR Remotely via ZOOM 
 
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://zoom.us/j/96458163787?pwd=cy0Oo4cojlRpMP3XzAx4UkLjx6FjMg.1 
Meeting ID: 964 5816 3787 
Passcode: 240456 
 
In attendance:  
Nate Besio, Chair (NB) 
Jon Adams-Kollitz (JAK) 
Lisa Black (LB) 
Meaghan Diffenderfer (MD) 
Karen Downey (KD) 
Sharon Henault (SH) 
Ashley Parker (AP) 
Katherine Schad (KS) 
John Thomas (JT) 
 
Others in Attendance:  
Sophie Sauve, BPRW Planning Division Director 
 
Start time 3:02 pm  
 
1. Adopt the Agenda 
• Motion by KD 
• Seconded by JT 
• All in favor, so moved and adopted 
 
2. Adopt Minutes 
• Motion by KS to adopt minutes from June 15, 2026 Meeting
• Seconded by AP 
• All in favor, so moved and adopted  
 
2. Introductions 
• The committee skipped this section as no guests were present. 
 
3. Public Forum 
• None 
 
5. Committee News & Updates 
• Ward 6 Polling Place update: Ward 6 polling entrance is now 
through the front door for everyone, and there will be clear 
signage for everyone about the change.  
• JT shares that a client filled out an application to public works with 
issues at the crosswalk at Riverside and Hillside; the intersection 
will be updated by the DPW team and they are going to add time 
to the pedestrian phase of the light cycle.  
• NB commends the new crosswalk on Main St.  
• NB makes note that this Saturday, July 26 is the 36th anniversary 
of the Americans with Disabilities Act.  
o The committee discussed drafting a press release.  
o It is noted that the last formal observation the City had of this 
passing was a celebration of the ADA at Oakledge for the 25th 
anniversary in 2015. 
• Tomorrow, July 21st is the grand re-opening of Pomeroy 
Playground at 2 pm!  
• Nate’s power soccer team won their National division!  
 
6. Potential New Member 
• Jacqueline Kelley, UVM Accessibility Partner  
o Motion by LB to nominate Jacqueline Kelley for membership to 
the HRPC. 
o Seconded by KD  
o All in favor, so moved and approved.  
 
7. PlanBTV 2050 Discussion 
• How do we define “achieving true accessibility”?  
o Committee members created a list of what they think this 
means. 
• Finalize wishlist for PlanBTV 2050 team.
o To be parsed down and shared with PlanBTV 2050 
Engagement Team 
 
8. Other Committee Business 
• Jon shares upcoming PlanBTV 2050 Events:  
o Another major public open house meeting in October  
o If there’s a desire to meet again with engagement team, they 
are open to coming to another meeting.  
• Next meeting September 21, 2026.  
9. Adjournment 
 
Meeting ended, 3:59 pm
